lines.2: That was what happened when somebody woke me up in the middle of the night.
lines.3: I answered Subaru's wake-up call and headed downstairs.
lines.7: Then I went next door to the Kanisawas'. (Even the nameplate on their house has a crab on it.)
lines.9: 「How about taking that one off my hands as your bride?」
lines.10: 「I'd rather not marry a girl dumb enough to fall into the ocean reenacting Titanic.」
lines.11: 「I know. If I were a man, I wouldn't want her either.」
lines.14: 「Honk-shoo... Yoppi is... seriously stacked under those clothes...」
lines.15: Now that was an intriguing bit of sleep talk.
lines.18: 「Mmm... kind of dumb, so I have to... take care of him... but lately he's getting the wrong idea...」
lines.20: I kicked Crab right out of bed.
lines.22: 「Morning. See you downstairs in twenty minutes. And don't do your morning Dead thing.」
lines.23: 「No way. My day begins with Dead and ends with Dead.」
